'''Traxes BioElectronics''' was a company that was well known for producing equipment that aided in strength and aerobic training. The corporation produced the [[Implant communicator]], the [[Ultrawave Sight Enhancer]],<ref name="GFT" /> and the [[Myostim Couch]].<ref name="SOTESB" />
